summary: Tested Shopify auth graceful failure and Stripe checkout integration. Fixed a bug in AuthContext.js where loginWithShopify was causing 'body stream already read' error. All critical features working: Shopify auth returns 501 with proper error, Stripe checkout works for authenticated users from both Settings page and Landing page pricing section.

minor.issue: Returns 500 instead of 400 for invalid plan or missing origin_url

issues: Console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - Recharts rendering issue, non-blocking

action_items: Optional: Improve error handling in create-checkout endpoint to return 400 for invalid plan/missing origin instead of 500
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: AuthContext.js loginWithShopify() was reading response.text() before JSON.parse which caused 'body stream already read' error - changed to direct response.json()
Console warning about chart dimensions is a known Recharts issue with responsive containers - non-blocking

success_rate.backend: 88% (15/17 tests passed - 2 minor edge case failures)

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed users for checkout testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Shopify auth gracefully returns 501 when SHOPIFY_API_KEY not set. Stripe checkout is fully functional with test API key. Bug fix applied to AuthContext.js loginWithShopify function. Landing page pricing CTAs redirect to Stripe when authenticated, and to /auth when not authenticated.

bug_fix_applied.issue: loginWithShopify() was causing 'body stream already read' error on frontend toast
bug_fix_applied.root_cause: Code was calling response.text() then trying to JSON.parse() that text, which can cause issues in some cases
bug_fix_applied.fix: Changed to direct response.json() call with try/catch for error handling
